scenes.caption: Keep the cord stump clean and dry
scenes.narration_line: Keep your baby’s cord stump clean and dry every day.

scenes.caption: Keep hygiene while handling your baby
scenes.narration_line: Keep things hygienic whenever you handle your baby.

scenes.caption: Do not apply anything to the cord
scenes.narration_line: Do not apply anything to your baby's cord.
safety_points: Keep the cord and umbilicus dry.

scenes.caption: Get help for redness, swelling or pus
scenes.narration_line: For redness, swelling, or pus, contact your doctor immediately.
safety_points: Seek medical care immediately for these signs.
